objective: Complete the NACA 0012 ladders on the TMR-distributed grids: 225x65 and 449x129 at alpha 10, then full ladders at alpha 0 and 15, with observed order and Richardson values against the published finest-grid results
rationale: The conversion pipeline is proven: the 113x33 rung at alpha 10 converged flat (Cl and Cd steady to 6e-8 over the final 50 iterations) in 95 seconds; the remaining rungs are the same pipeline pointed at the finer files
citations: NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource: NACA 0012 validation case and distributed grids (turbmodels.larc.nasa.gov)
expected_knowledge_gain: First lifting-body ladder; whether the verification discipline holds when pressure drag and lift dominate
launch_prompt: Run workflows.tmr_verification.run_naca_level for (medium, fine) x (10, 0, 15 degrees) sequentially with detach=True and collect_level, honoring the STOP file before every launch; then build the per-alpha summaries with build_naca_summary and persist_naca_ladder, and only then touch the card.
